examples.question_text: For this example, stamp duty is 3% of the vehicle value up to $\$45\,000$, plus 5% of any value above $\$45\,000$. A car's purchase price and market value are both $\$28\,400$. Calculate the stamp duty payable.
examples.solution_text:
The vehicle value is below $\$45\,000$, so apply 3% to the whole value.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Stamp duty} &= 3\% \times \$28\,400 \\ &= 0.03 \times \$28\,400 \\ &= \$852\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: For this example, stamp duty is 3% of the vehicle value up to $\$45\,000$, plus 5% of any value above $\$45\,000$. A new car's purchase price and market value are both $\$63\,500$. Calculate the stamp duty payable.
examples.solution_text:
Calculate the excess above $\$45\,000$.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Excess} &= \$63\,500 - \$45\,000 \\ &= \$18\,500\end{aligned}$

Apply 3% to the first $\$45\,000$ and 5% to the excess.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Stamp duty} &= 0.03 \times \$45\,000 + 0.05 \times \$18\,500 \\ &= \$1350 + \$925 \\ &= \$2275\end{aligned}$

methods.description: For a vehicle value up to and including $45,000, multiply the value by 0.03.
